name: axon
description: Semantic, tree-first computer use for Windows. Drives desktop apps through the UI Automation accessibility tree instead of screenshots, so targeting is precise, DPI-proof, and about 20x cheaper in tokens. Adds to Claude Code's built-in computer use; never replaces it.

blocked_apps.title: Additional blocked apps
blocked_apps.description: Comma-separated process names Axon must never read or drive, on top of its built-in blocklist. Example: myvault,internal-admin
